name: link
need: Navigate: a link in text, a standalone link, an external link with its icon, or a quiet secondary link

--ds-link-font.description: the type of a standalone link (`.ds-link--standalone`); an inline link takes the type of its text

ripple..ds-link: a link that navigates, inline or standalone: no ripple and no morph (they would reach outside the text line); the underline is its press
